gaps.term: exponent formula for the per-volume cost
gaps.quote: In general the per-volume cost grows like $f^{\log_m(s/W)}$ as the parameter grows to $f$
gaps.note: The page asserts the general formula without derivation. The reader would need to see that after k levels the parameter is m^k and the per-volume factor is (s/W)^k, then rewrite k = log_m f using a logarithm power identity. The claim that the exponent is below 1 also needs m > 1, which the page never states.
